description: The system is based on a NodeMCU and an Arduino UNO board (for the hardware device), a website created with PHP, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Javascript, jQuery and a MySQL database. The hardware device will read RFID cards, store their information, and send it to the website which will process the data and then modify it/store it in the SQL database, then send a response to the device so it can print a message on an LCD screen and also write the result on a micro SD card. This repository contains all the files from my 2020 Applied Electronics Engineering BS diploma project
